def cw(m): return [list(row) for row in zip(*m[::-1])]
def ccw(m): return [list(row) for row in zip(*m)][::-1]
def rot180(m): return [r[::-1] for r in m[::-1]]
parts=[a,cw(a),ccw(a),rot180(a)]
